title: Vintage Playboy Magazine Sept 1985 Madonna - Complete Centerfold
descriptionText: The product is a vintage Playboy magazine from September 1985 featuring Madonna on the cover and complete with the centerfold. This collectible magazine falls under the genre of history and offers a glimpse into the popular culture and entertainment of the 1980s. With iconic photographs and articles, this issue provides a nostalgic look back at the past and is a must-have for fans of vintage magazines or Madonna enthusiasts.
